items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: this is Buddy Williams playing drums but he has an understanding about that New Orleans

ctx.x: This is Idris Muhammad playing drums. No I’m sorry, this is not Idris, he’s on a previous album, this is Buddy Williams playing drums but he has an understanding about that New Orleans — he sees where he’s coming from playing. That whole marching band snare drum.
I can just see it going down the street. I mean I’ve only been to New Orleans once but I heard it.
